title: Binary search: return the index
prompt: Implement `int binary_search_index(const std::vector<int>& v, int target)` returning the index of `target` in the **sorted** vector, or -1 when absent. Use the classic two-pointer loop with `mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2`.

tests.name: found
tests.hint: First, middle, and last positions all work.

tests.name: missing
tests.hint: Below, between, and beyond — all absent.

tests.name: empty
tests.hint: Empty input is absent, not a crash.

tests.name: two-elements
tests.hint: The tiny case where boundary bugs live.
